title: Cache files written non-atomically; a truncated partial becomes a permanent 'cache hit' that breaks every later bake
evidence:
if os.path.exists(path):
            print(f"[fetch] cache hit: {path}")
            continue
...
            with open(path, "w") as f:
                f.write(text)
detail: Interruption mid-write leaves a truncated JSON at the final cache path; os.path.exists then reports 'cache hit' forever and load_raw's json.load crashes. No temp+rename, no recovery path.
recommended_fix: Write to path+'.part' then os.replace() into place; optionally json.load-validate cache hits before trusting them.

title: Relation member geometries concatenated into ONE LineString — multipolygon water relations become zigzags that drop or mangle
detail: GEOM_QUERY fetches natural=water / riverbank relations, but all member ways' points join into a single line; polygonize then yields an invalid zigzag (dropped) or nonsense ring. Per-member rings needed.
recommended_fix: Build one geometry per member (or per outer ring) and union members instead of concatenating points across members.

title: Unused imports: io and shapely.geometry.shape
evidence:
import io
...
from shapely.geometry import LineString, Point, Polygon, shape
detail: Neither io nor shape is referenced anywhere in the 593-line file; element_geometry builds Points manually.
recommended_fix: Delete 'import io' and drop shape from the shapely.geometry import list.

title: 'if args.bake or True:' is always true — the --bake flag value is dead
evidence:
if args.bake or True:
        fetch_raw(args.cache)  # cache-first: no network when present
detail: After --fetch/--verify early-return, the condition is vacuous; args.bake is never read. Sloppy guard that will confuse future flag additions.
recommended_fix: Replace with 'if args.bake or not (args.fetch or args.verify):' or a plain unconditional block with a comment.

title: DP_TOL["coast"] is defined but never used; the 'coast' output layer actually contains beaches
evidence:
"coast": 12.0,   # long shoreline ways — heavy simplification is the point
...
if nat == "coastline" or ww == "riverbank" or nat == "water" or ww == "canal" or ww == "dock":
...
coast = merge_and_emit(beach_rings, MIN_AREA["coast"])
detail: Coastline ways are simplified with DP_TOL["water"] (8.0), never 12.0; 'coast' rings come from beach_rings. Dead constant plus misleading layer naming.
recommended_fix: Apply DP_TOL["coast"] to nat=='coastline' or delete it; rename the beach layer or comment the mismatch.

title: MIN_AREA water comment claims '~220 m x 220 m'; at the baked scale 0.01 tile² is ~72 m × 72 m
evidence:
"water": 0.01,   # ~220 m x 220 m at this scale — ponds read as dots
...
"park": 0.1,     # ~2 football fields — real parks only
detail: Asset bakes scale_tiles_per_m=0.0013971214, so 0.01 tile² ≈ 71.6 m side; ~226 m belongs to park's 0.1. Comment misleads future noise-floor tuning by ~3× linear.
recommended_fix: Fix comment to ~70 m × 70 m (and re-check park's '~2 football fields' vs ~5 ha).

title: Docstring district filter omits 'village' but query fetches it and asset carries 13 village districts
detail: Pipeline description and bake filter both include village; only the module docstring's list skips it. Baked asset contains 13 village districts.
recommended_fix: Add 'village' to the docstring's place list.

title: certifi load failure swallowed by bare 'except Exception: pass', contradicting the 'certifi CA needed' claim
detail: Field notes say framework Python fails CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED without certifi; here that absence is silently ignored, resurfacing later as an opaque per-mirror SSL error.
recommended_fix: On ImportError, print an explicit 'pip install certifi' warning (or hard-fail) instead of passing silently.

title: Missing palette key silently renders opaque black instead of erroring
evidence:
if v is None or len(v) < 4:
        return (0, 0, 0, 255)
detail: A renamed/absent token (water, canvas, ink_soft…) yields invisible-or-black geometry with no message — palette.json is the 'look-book oracle' per the docstring.
recommended_fix: Raise (or loudly warn) naming the missing palette key and view.

title: Byte-identical determinism contract stated while shapely/pyproj are explicitly unpinned
evidence:
Determinism contract: same cached raw response -> byte-identical
...
`python3 -c "import shapely, pyproj"` are the only hard deps besides the
stdlib
detail: UTM projection and simplification results shift across PROJ/shapely versions; same cache on a different environment can fail --verify. Contract lacks version pinning.
recommended_fix: Record shapely/pyproj/PROJ versions in the asset's extract block, or scope the contract to one environment.

title: .osm-cache/ (OSM data cache) filed under the '# Python cache' heading
detail: The new ignore entry is an Overpass response cache, not a Python cache; grouping under the wrong comment heading invites future confusion.
recommended_fix: Move .osm-cache/ under its own comment (e.g. '# OSM snapshot cache (tools/osm_extract.py)').
